description: This file defines the RouteContext class within the Slim Routing namespace, responsible for managing routing context information such as route, parser, routing results, and base path, particularly when creating context from an HTTP server request.

classes.name: RouteContext
classes.description: Final class responsible for encapsulating route-related information in the Slim Framework, including methods to create a context from a server request and access route data.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Creates a new RouteContext instance from a PSR-7 ServerRequest object, extracting routing attributes and throwing an exception if routing is incomplete.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Returns the associated route object, if any.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the route parser used in the current context.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path string; throws RuntimeException if not set.
